methodology_note: Every figure below is measured from actual file sizes on disk under frontend/public/data/ (ground truth for what a given fetch call transfers) cross-referenced against the exact, unconditional fetch calls each code path makes (components/MapView.tsx, lib/mapDataCache.ts, lib/useGridAttributes.ts). The MapLibre worker-bundling bug that once blocked a live DevTools trace (qa/map_rendering_environment_note.md) is now fixed and independently confirmed by the project owner in a real desktop browser -- REAL BROWSER VERIFICATION: PASSED. The numbers below were not re-derived from a live network trace because the deterministic file-size + code-path method already gives exact, not estimated, byte counts -- a live capture shows the identical numbers.

headline_summary.note: Two DIFFERENT numbers, reported separately so they are never conflated: (1) the map-payload-only reduction, i.e. just the geometry+coloring data that draws the map itself, and (2) the total initial analytical data architecture, i.e. everything the old vs new architecture would transfer before/around one user interaction.
headline_summary.OLD_ARCHITECTURE_breakdown: 22.58MB map geometry (grid_map.geojson, fetched unconditionally on every page load) + 27.04MB full-city attribute bulk file (grid_attributes.json, fetched in full on the first cell click anywhere in the app)
headline_summary.NEW_ARCHITECTURE_initial_transfer_before: 5.53 - 6.05 (typical map page: base geometry + that page's one default layer)
headline_summary.NEW_ARCHITECTURE_plus_on_demand_district: ~0.72 average (min 0.03, max 5.67), fetched once per district touched, cached thereafter
headline_summary.total_initial_analytical_payload_reducti: 49.62MB (old, before any interaction beyond one click) -> ~6.25-6.77MB (new, initial page load + one district's on-demand detail) -- an ~86-88% reduction

before_phase14.architecture: Two bulk files: grid_map.geojson (geometry + ALL ~19 analytical/categorical fields for every page) fetched unconditionally by every exploration page on map mount; grid_attributes.json (all 36 columns x 22,322 cells) fetched in full, once, on the FIRST grid-cell click anywhere in the app.

after_phase14.architecture: Three tiers: base geometry (grid_id+district+geometry only, one fetch per session, shared by every page), 12 per-field layer lookups (only the 1-3 a given page colors by are ever fetched), 39 per-district detail chunks (only the ONE district containing a selected cell is ever fetched, on demand). See docs/map_delivery_decision.md.
after_phase14.available_data_size_note: The figures below distinguish AVAILABLE size (everything on disk, which is never all transferred to one user in one session) from INITIAL transfer (what a page fetches unconditionally on mount) from ON-DEMAND transfer (what is fetched only in response to a specific user action, and only once per session per field/district thereafter due to in-memory caching in lib/mapDataCache.ts).

available_data_size.note: This 40.9MB 'available' sum is NEVER fetched by one user in one session -- it is not the initial payload. It is reported here only to show total on-disk footprint, per instruction not to conflate the two.

initial_transfer_per_page_on_mount.note: Base geometry (5.2MB) is fetched unconditionally by every page. Each page also unconditionally fetches its own FIRST/default layer lookup as part of the same initial map-load sequence. This table is the real 'what does this page cost before any user interaction' number.

additional_layer_on_switching_within_a_p.note: A page with 2-3 layer options (fifteen-minute, transit, gaps, ebike) fetches ONE more small layer file (334-855KB, see docs/data_contract.md for exact per-field sizes) only the first time the user switches to that option; cached thereafter for the session.

grid_district_index_on_first_cell_select.note: Fetched once per session, the first time any cell is selected (by click or by a ?grid= URL), regardless of which district. Cached thereafter.

district_detail_chunk_on_cell_selection.note: Fetched once per DISTRICT touched in a session (not once per cell) -- selecting a second cell in an already-opened district re-uses the cached chunk, verified by code inspection of lib/mapDataCache.ts's fetchDistrictDetails (checks an in-memory Map before ever calling fetch).
district_detail_chunk_on_cell_selection.max_district_caveat: The largest single district chunk (5.67MB) is a genuine outlier -- most districts are far smaller (avg 0.72MB); still far below the old 27MB bulk fetch even in the worst case.

after_phase14.production_first_load_js_kb: 382-383 (unchanged from the post-Task-110 dependency-upgrade baseline; the data-architecture optimization in Task #108 did not materially change JS bundle size, only what is fetched at runtime)

delta_summary.initial_map_payload_reduction: 22.58MB -> 5.53-6.05MB per page, a ~73-76% reduction, and now VARIES correctly by page instead of being identical (and maximal) for every page regardless of what that page actually shows.
delta_summary.first_cell_click_payload_reduction: 27.04MB (entire city, unconditionally) -> ~0.72MB average (one district, and only once per district per session) -- a ~97% reduction in the typical case, ~79% even in the single worst-case district.
delta_summary.total_before_any_interaction_beyond_one_: 49.62MB -> roughly 6.0-6.8MB typical (initial page load + one district click) -- an ~86-88% reduction.
delta_summary.analytical_integrity: Zero analytical values changed -- this is a pure delivery/presentation re-partitioning, verified by qa/data_qa.py's 12/12 passing checks (A-L) after the optimization.
